EF 后量子哈希签名挑战
summary: EIP-8430（从 8130 拆出的 AA 交易类型）开讨论帖，说明拆分理由：交易类型本身就有用，可先上线。EIP-8298 提交修订（10 月 2 日合并），`SETCODEFROM` 在 BAL 中只记录代码哈希，并拒绝同一交易内创建的源账户，避免一次 9,300 gas 的调用让 BAL 增加最多 24 KiB。EF 发起开放挑战，征集为后量子以太坊设计的无状态哈希签名并在 Lean 中证明安全。

items.topic: 账户与代码的状态成本
items.title: EIP-8298：BAL 中把采用的代码记为哈希，拒绝同一交易创建的源账户
items.note: （CPerezz）。EIP-7928 把每次代码哈希变化记为完整字节码，一次热源 `SETCODEFROM` 只花 9,300 gas，却可能让 BAL 增加最多 24 KiB；只记哈希则要求字节码在别处可找到，同一交易内创建又自毁的源账户会让哈希无字节码可查。
items.title_en: EIP-8298: record adopted code as a hash in the BAL and reject same-transaction-created sources
items.note_en: (CPerezz). EIP-7928 records every code hash change as full bytecode, so one warm-source `SETCODEFROM` at 9,300 gas could add up to 24 KiB to the BAL; a hash-only entry needs the bytecode findable elsewhere, and a source created and self-destructed in the same transaction would leave the hash with no bytecode anywhere.

keywords_en: EIP-8298 records code hashes in the BAL
summary_en: EIP-8430 (the AA transaction type split out of 8130) opened its discussion thread, explaining the split: the transaction type is useful on its own and can ship first. EIP-8298 submitted a revision (merged October 2) so `SETCODEFROM` records only the code hash in the BAL and rejects sources created in the same transaction, preventing one 9,300 gas call from adding up to 24 KiB to the BAL. The EF launched an open challenge to design stateless hash-based signatures for post-quantum Ethereum and prove them secure in Lean.
